note: Weekly content system. Opportunities (deadlines, open calls, jobs) and big local news may replace any slot. Re-weighted monthly from performance.json.

academy.what: AI skills for students and engineers: explainers, tools, prompts, how-tos. Never imply AIS Academy has a running course.

studio.what: Founders and venture building: founder lessons, behind the scenes, startup stories from Uzbekistan.

corporate.what: AI adoption in companies: use cases, myths vs facts, what managers should do.

ventures.what: Funding and the ecosystem: rounds, investors, how to raise, AIS Ventures' thesis.

news.what: One important AI or ecosystem story with our opinion and the 'so what for Tashkent'.

Mon.brief: The week's 3 most important AI / ecosystem stories and what each means in Uzbekistan. Carousel on IG and LinkedIn, digest on Telegram.

Tue.brief: One AI tool or technique students and founders can use this week: what it does, 3 steps to try it, a realistic limitation.

Wed.brief: A founder lesson or startup story from Uzbekistan / Central Asia (named founders need sign-off), or a behind-the-scenes from AIS Studio from the leads' inputs.

Thu.brief: One concrete company use case or a myth-vs-fact for managers, with a number from a credible source.

Fri.brief: Central Asia deals of the week (Stanbase, The Tech, Spot) and one investor takeaway for founders.

Sat.brief: Open calls, grants, hackathons, programs and deadlines useful to the audience (external ones; check the deadline is still open).

Sun.brief: Optional: only if the story bank has a very strong story (score >= 0.75) or the leads sent an idea.

always: Opportunities with a deadline in the next 7 days beat the series slot (they are the channel's best performers).
An idea sent by a lead beats the series slot unless it is time-insensitive.
Event days (ICT Week, InnoWeek, demo days, cohort launches) replace the slot with pre-event / live / recap posts.
